items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 49:1
items.html: The words “remoteness” and “nearness” are used essentially only with respect to the light of Hochma: “remote” means a scant illumination of the light of Hochma, and “near” means an abundant illumination of the light of Hochma — in the secret of the verse, “I said, I will be wise, but it was far from me.” (p. 635, Item 40)
